messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Customers face delays in resolving critical issues just before a high-volume claims period. Without timely fixes, operations risk disruption during peak demand.",
 "similar": [
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4133",
   "similarity": 0.054,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater's document classifier confidence threshold setting allows users to define the minimum confidence level required for automatic categorization of claims documents, ensuring only high-certainty classifications are applied without manual review.\", \"id\": 4133, \"name\": \"Document classifier confidence threshold\", \"started\": false, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 1}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4128",
   "similarity": 0.037,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater now allows users to filter claims by date range, status, and claim type, making it easier to locate specific claims without scrolling through unrelated entries.\", \"id\": 4128, \"name\": \"Claim search refinements\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4129",
   "similarity": 0.036,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater automatically pulls and updates supplier contact details from integrated systems, ensuring claims handlers always have the most current information without manual entry.\", \"id\": 4129, \"name\": \"Supplier contact details\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4135",
   "similarity": 0.036,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater's claim information display provides a clear, real-time overview of active claims, including status, assigned adjuster, and key dates, helping users stay informed without switching screens.\", \"id\": 4135, \"name\": \"Claim information display\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 2}"
  },
  {
   "source": "notion",
   "id": "02667fa8-ad6a-5f71-85e0-ab7f6a88ad86",
   "similarity": 0.034,
   "record": "{\"id\": \"02667fa8-ad6a-5f71-85e0-ab7f6a88ad86\", \"object\": \"page\", \"properties\": {\"Name\": {\"title\": [{\"plain_text\": \"Summer release notes\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"Summer release notes\"}, \"type\": \"text\"}], \"type\": \"title\"}, \"Problem\": {\"rich_text\": [{\"plain_text\": \"Keelwater's Summer release notes detail new features, bug fixes, and performance improvements for the claims processing system, ensuring smoother workflows and enhanced user experience.\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"Keelwater's Summer release notes detail new features, bug fixes, and performance improvements for the claims processing system, ensuring smoother workflows and enhanced user experience.\"}, \"type\": \"text\"}], \"type\": \"rich_text\"}, \""
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the problem statement (delays in resolving critical issues before a high-volume claims period) against all five similar items. None match: story 4133 (document classifier confidence threshold, unstarted) and 4135 (claim information display, in progress) are different problems; 4128 (claim search filters) and 4129 (supplier contact sync) are completed but solve unrelated problems; the Notion Summer release notes page is generic and does not cover this specific pre-peak-delay risk. No shipped story or roadmap item addresses timely fixes ahead of peak claims volume.", "verdict": "pass"}
